instruction: Display category number and topology information of the current map in Grass GIS.

evaluate.key: lambda dump: any([param.get('name') == 'display' and all([val in str(param.get('value', '')).split(',') for val in ['cat', 'topo']]) for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict) for param in (data.get('params') or [])]) or any([isinstance(cmd, list) and len(cmd) > 1 and cmd[0] == 'd.vect' and ((isinstance(cmd[1], dict) and str(cmd[1].get('map', '')).startswith('boundary_region') and all([val in str(cmd[1].get('display', '')).split(',') for val in ['cat', 'topo']])) or (any([isinstance(part, str) and part.startswith('map=boundary_region') for part in cmd[1:]]) and any([isinstance(part, str) and part.startswith('display=') and all([val in part.split('=', 1)[1].split(',') for val in ['cat', 'topo']]) for part in cmd[1:]]))) for cmd in ([item.get('cmd') for item in dump.get('layers', []) if item.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and item.get('hidden') is not True] + [data.get('cmd') for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict)])])
